title: Catan
statusNote: Logos, title, menus, options and the tutorial list work. A single-player Free Game against three computer players loads and plays: the turn order is rolled, the opponents place their settlements, and the player moves the cursor over the board and builds a settlement.
notes: 5 confirms everywhere (the title asks for it) and 7 cancels; the OK key is not the confirm key in this game.
When choosing opponents, the "?" tiles are characters that are still locked and cannot be picked; choose three different unlocked ones, then confirm with 5.
Either soft key opens the System menu in a match (Help, Options, Quit).
Multiplayer needs Bluetooth, which is not available here.

controls.source: Options > Key Config (2 construction window, 3 card data window; neither opened during the opening settlement phase), the game's own prompts ("OK=key 5, Cancel=key 7"), and the cursor and soft keys as seen in a match.

actions.right: Move the cursor right; next page (help)
actions.5: Confirm: select, roll the dice, build, next message

notes: Arrows move the cursor; Enter or Space is the 5 key (confirm) and Backspace is 7 (cancel). 2 and 3 open the construction and card windows; Q or Escape opens the System menu.
